name: The Barrow Way
description_md:
The Barrow Way is a walking route in IE that spans 116.3 km. It is part of the national waymarked hiking network and is signposted as BW.

This route features 166 m of ascent and 250 m of descent. It is classified as hard due to the distance and ascent. The walking time is about 30 hours on the DIN 33466 hiking time rule.
